{{Top|ga}} {{Character |type=First Order |image=[[File:Lanzora-Garan-TROSVD.png]] |name=Lanzora Garan |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' |gender= |pronouns=She/her |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Black]] |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Tan |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[First Order]] **[[First Order military]] |masters= |apprentices= }} [[Lieutenant]] '''Lanzora Garan''' was a [[human]] who served in the [[First Order]] as a [[security officer]] on board the [[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|''Steadfast'']], [[flagship]] of [[Supreme Leader]] [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]]. Tasked with keeping an [[eye]] on inter-[[Starship|ship]] communication, she had direct lines of contact to members of the [[First Order Supreme Council]] and [[First Order Security Bureau]] command. In [[35 ABY]], she witnessed [[Allegiant General]] [[Enric Pryde]] [[Death|kill]] the [[spy]] [[General]] [[Armitage Hux]] on the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of the ''Steadfast''. ==Biography== {{Quote|Get me the Supreme Leader.''"
"''Yes, sir.''"
"''Tell him we've found our spy.|Pryde speaks to a First Order officer while executing Hux in front of Garan|audio=Pryde-Spy-TROS.flac|{{Film|IX}}}} Lanzora Garan was a [[human]] who served as a [[lieutenant]] in the [[First Order military|forces]] of the [[First Order]] during its [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[Resistance]]. In [[35 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IX}} to [[35 ABY]]. she was stationed as a [[security officer]] on board the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|''Steadfast'']], [[flagship]] of [[Supreme Leader]] [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]]. Garan was tasked with keeping a close [[eye]] on inter-[[Starship|ship]] signals for any indication of compromised communication lines or activity by enemy agents. She had direct lines of communication to [[First Order Supreme Council]] members [[Allegiant General]] [[Enric Pryde]] and [[General]] [[Armitage Hux]] as well as [[First Order Security Bureau]] command. [[File:Garan-TROS.png|thumb|left|300px|Lanzora Garan witnessed the execution of General Hux by Allegiant General Pryde on board the ''Steadfast''.]] After the [[Jedi]]-in-[[Jedi training|training]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] and her allies [[Mission to Kijimi|infiltrated]] and then escaped from the ''Steadfast'' while it was above the [[planet]] [[Kijimi]], Garan was on the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of the [[Star Destroyer]] when Hux reported to Pryde on how their foes had forced him to aid them in fleeing. As Garan watched, Pryde shot and [[Death|killed]] Hux, having realized that the general was in fact a [[spy]] who had been aiding the Resistance. Shortly after Hux's death, the First Order was defeated and the ''Steadfast'' destroyed during the [[Battle of Exegol]]. ==Personality and traits== Despite the tight security on board the ''Steadfast'', Garan did not slack in her attentiveness. She had [[Color|tan]] skin, brown eyes, and black [[hair]]. ==Equipment== Garan wore a gray [[First Order military uniforms|First Order officer's uniform]] with a high stiff collar that ensured proper posture was maintained. The uniform also included a gray [[Hat|cap]], two [[code cylinder]]s, a black [[belt]], and black [[boot]]s. ==Behind the scenes== Lanzora Garan was portrayed by [[Mandeep Dhillon]] in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']]. The film's credits identified her as "Lieutenant Garan," with the character's first name being provided in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. ==Appearances== *{{Film|IX}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' {{1stID|Lanzora}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Lanzora Garan}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Lanzora Garan |es=Lanzora Garan |fr=Lanzora Garan |ja=ランゾラ・ギャラン |ka=ლანზორა გარანი |pl=Lanzora Garan }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Garan, Lanzora}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:Officers of the First Order]]
